newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER SHOWCASE-BARCELONA AND ATLETICO IN THRILLING 3-3 DRAW.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER SHOWCASE-BARCELONA AND ATLETICO IN THRILLING 3-3 DRAW.

text.p: Barcelona and Atletico Madrid lived up to their no-holds-barred reputations on Saturday, sharing in a thrilling 3-3 draw in a top Spanish first division match at Nou Camp after the lead had changed hands three times.
Champions Atletico went ahead after six minutes through Spain midfielder Jose Luis Caminero.
But Barcelona hit back through striker Juan Pizzi and Luis Enrique Martinez to lead 2-1 at halftime.
The visitors equalised on the hour thanks to Juan Vizcaino and then regained the lead from the penalty spot 13 minutes later through Argentine Juan Esnaider.
But Brazilian Giovanni struck 12 minutes from time to earn Barcelona a point and ensure their unbeaten record this season remained intact.
